definitions.explanation: Describes a sincere and focused dedication to something, pursuing a goal with unwavering commitment and pure intention.

examples.japanese: ひたむき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧。
ひたむきな⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}たれた→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the earnest dedication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ひたむき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける→走り続ける：22070_hashiritsuzukeru⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I wanted to support her as she single-mindedly kept running toward her dream.

notes:
ひたむき describes a pure, unwavering focus and dedication. It has a strongly positive connotation, suggesting sincerity and admirable perseverance.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: ひたむき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- Noun modifier: ひたむきな + noun
- Noun form: ひたむきさ (earnestness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひたむき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧: to try one's hardest wholeheartedly
- ひたむきな⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: devoted effort
- ひたむきな⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧: devoted love
- ひたむき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to tackle earnestly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧: with all one's might (more everyday)
- ⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧: serious, earnest (more about seriousness)
- ひたむき emphasizes purity of heart and single-minded devotion.
